### 4.2 Detailed Requirements

For each feature (especially Must-haves), describe:
- User flow
- Inputs and outputs
- Business rules
- Edge cases

### 4.3 Acceptance Criteria

Use Given/When/Then or a checklist. Every Must-have feature must have explicit, testable acceptance criteria.

## 7. Release Criteria

### 7.1 Definition of Done
- [ ] All Must-have features shipped and accepted
- [ ] All acceptance criteria pass
- [ ] Non-functional requirements met (with measurements)
- [ ] Security review complete
- [ ] Accessibility review complete
- [ ] Legal/compliance review complete (if applicable)
- [ ] Documentation updated (user guide, API docs, runbooks)
- [ ] Monitoring and alerting in place
